author: Praxis III
title: SoftPower‑DAQB MPB: p=1.5, tau_q=0.70 (R² threshold), δ=0.10, kd=20, k=48
abstract: Same as SoftPower‑DAQB but τ at 70th percentile of R² to be more selective. Tests whether sparing more moderate‑R² PCs improves label metrics while maintaining mixing.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from softpower_daqb_mpb import eliminate_softpower_daqb_mpb

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return eliminate_softpower_daqb_mpb(
        adata,
        p_exp=1.5,
        tau_mode='quantile',
        tau_q=0.70,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=20,
        k_total=48
    )
